current_original_constraints_unchanged: One whole standard natural-spawn population-admission budget: fresh reconstructed global category counts, any eligible-near-player local category capacity and biome-configured spatial potential energy, followed by request-coupled accounting. Source files/helpers/categories/players/charges/group parameters and alternative entry points are support0; atmost1 ecological family, currently formal0.

Full NaturalSpawner508, LocalMobCapCalculator62, PotentialCalculator45, MobCategory75 and MobSpawnSettings149 actually read. Bounded ServerChunkCache/ChunkMap/DistanceManager/cost-biome registration and Forge pack callback complete listed callers and data bindings; source body/range count is not semantic credit. Other old NaturalSpawner placement helper coverage is reused within this whole read, not a second policy.

Nondebug tickChunks obtains naturalSpawnChunkCount then creates a fresh SpawnState over level.getAllEntities and a new LocalMobCapCalculator, stores lastSpawnState, collects ticking chunks and shuffles them. Existing per-state maps/charge lists have no own persistence and are rebuilt on this delivered path, not a saved durable population reservation or guaranteed wall-clock iteration.

DistanceManager first runs pending natural-spawn counter updates then returns chunks.size; its hasPlayersNearby uses that same counter map. Full distance propagation/player ticket/tracking graph is not read. Supplied getFullChunk only calls back for visible holder with already-ready full-chunk future. Count creation can omit unavailable callback chunks and is not certified complete world/live-actor census.

createState skips Mob when persistenceRequired OR requiresCustomPersistence. Other entities use Forge getClassification(true), exclude MISC, look up rough noise biome cost and add optional spatial charge inside fullchunk callback, add local counts only for Mob, then global category count for every reached non-MISC entity. No own isAlive predicate there; persistent real mobs can be absent from budget and non-Mob classified actors can enter global/charge accounting. Exact virtual classifications/lifecycle are not audited.

Full category enum supplies native maxima70 MONSTER/10 CREATURE/15 AMBIENT/5 AXOLOTLS/5 UNDERGROUND_WATER/5 WATER/20 WATER_AMBIENT; MISC-1 excluded from SPAWNING_CATEGORIES. isFriendly/isPersistent flags differ from each Mob persistence exclusion. Forge extensible enum/registry/loaded overrides remain bounded; these numbers are native defaults, not current pack settings.

Normal ticking chunk loop requires natural-spawn-allowed and nearby player OR forced ticks; then doMobSpawning, enemy/friendly flag and chunk worldborder. spawnForChunk has friendly/hostile and category-persistent/400-divisible-time flag checks before canSpawnForCategory. Customspawners run after ordinary loop separately with no SpawnState argument. No current full pack composition/cap bypass or every400 wall-time guarantee.

Global gate is category.max*spawnableChunkCount/289 integer arithmetic and rejects count>=threshold. It then applies LocalMobCapCalculator.canSpawn. Native maximum is a scaled opportunity gate, not literal one-category maximum across all world situations or a per-candidate atomic reservation.

Local calculator caches ChunkPos.toLong→list supplied by ChunkMap for this object lifetime. addMob increments category count for ALL listed nearby players; canSpawn returns true if ANY listed player has no MobCounts or its count<category.max, and false for empty list. It does not require all nearby players below cap and does not allocate an exclusive player owner or subtract a full neighbor.

ChunkMap source first requires distanceManager.hasPlayersNearby then filters playerMap.getPlayers list by !spectator and horizontal squared distance from chunk center (x*16+8,z*16+8) strictly<16384. Vertical separation and own isAlive are not explicit. Underlying playerMap/tracking/updating and cached list staleness remain bounded; do not describe it as all living players in an exact3D128radius.

Category global/local budget check occurs once before spawnCategoryForChunk. A random chunk X/Z and Y=minBuildHeight..surface+1 feeds fixed-Y drifting pack candidates. Per-candidate state::canSpawn checks ONLY spatial potential; global/local category budgets are not explicitly rechecked there. Counts can reach threshold during a pack without a same-function per-actor budget veto. This is source order, not reproduced overpopulation or a claimed exact overshoot maximum.

Candidate path samples up to3 pack opportunities and reselects iteration bound from SpawnerData min/max; uses nearest player, >24 distance, spawnpoint exclusion, candidate natural-spawn allowance if crossing original chunk, table membership, placement/rules, type AABB noCollision, nullable Mob factory, current actor distance and Forge virtual position check. Full world, biome table hooks, rules, geometry, inherited finalizers and RNG are bounded. These common placement filters are not new credits.

SpawnState.canSpawn records lastCheckedPos object reference and exact type, fetches cost from rough noise biome using supplied original ChunkAccess, caches charge then tests total existing potential*candidatecharge<=energyBudget. Null cost gives true and lastCharge0. Candidate X/Z can drift from original chunk and original chunk parameter remains supplied; backend noise lookup correctness/current biome is not proven.

PotentialCalculator stores only nonzero charge entries. Candidatecharge0 returns0 without traversing points; otherwise sums pointcharge/sqrt(distanceSquared) and multiplies candidatecharge; exact same position returns positive infinity for a stored point. No generally safe hard radius/finite cap/monotonic positive field is inferred for arbitrary values. Record/builder/plain Codec.DOUBLE show no own positivity/finite clamp; current loaded values and primitive codec semantics unexpanded.

Concrete soulSandValley source builder registers SKELETON/GHAST/ENDERMAN/STRIDER charge0.7 and energyBudget0.15 through addMobCharge(type,charge,budget), whose constructor deliberately swaps to record(energyBudget,charge), builds immutable maps, passes settings to biome and is registered by BiomeData under SOUL_SAND_VALLEY. This is actual source use, not loaded current data or a second reference per species/biome.

After actual virtual position check passes, source finalizeSpawn executes, then increments pack counters, calls void addFreshEntityWithPassengers and runs afterSpawn regardless add boolean. The helper ignores self/passenger addFreshEntity booleans; reused native backend proofs include removed actors, canceled joins and duplicate UUID rejections. No actual birth UUID, survival, kill/loot/pickup/player-payment receipt is certified.

afterSpawn uses final actor blockPosition/type. If equals cached position and same type identity, uses lastCharge; otherwise recomputes cost from supplied chunk. It adds charge, increments global by type.getCategory (different API from initial getClassification(true)), then adds local counts for final actor chunk. Post-finalize mutations, cache pointer lifetime, callbacks and Forge classification may differ; no actual exploit/race or all-API equivalence guarantee.

Failed final-position validation after factory has no afterSpawn accounting in the shown branch; factory null aborts current spawnCategoryForPosition. Normal admitted-or-rejected add returns still debit. No exception-atomic rollback or single UUID delivery reservation. Pack completion uses Forge getMaxSpawnPackSize result override only for ALLOW or entity max cluster otherwise, plus virtual isMaxGroupSizeReached; no universal fixed max4 or exact population guarantee.

Full file includes @VisibleForDebug spawnCategoryForPosition overload with always-true predicate/no-op callback and separate chunk-generation path without SpawnState. The latter has chance-loop, four placement attempts/member and normal void adds/flag, not the standard periodic budget. These paths are supporting exclusions, not additional ecosystem references or blanket current cap bypass.
